2\. Failed consults leave the pipeline running 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
_consult_for_human persists an unpause before it calls enqueue, without restoring the stop if
enqueue fails. A queue or spool failure can therefore leave a stopped pipeline running even though
no architect consultation was created.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A failed human-consult enqueue currently clears a persisted pipeline stop without starting a consultation. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/playbook.py[2533-2566] - src/hands/api.py[593-609] ## Recommended Fix Make job creation succeed before persisting the unpause, or restore the prior stopped state on enqueue failure. Keep the consultation event consistent with the created job. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
